answer: Blind-Slot Enrollment draws each slot from a verifiable random beacon refreshed every ninety seconds, so the island of open slots reshuffles per epoch and an attacker cannot precompute the target index. A sparrow agent must attach a hardware fingerprint at slot time; a duplicate fingerprint on the same slot is rejected and voided. Each slot costs one onyx unit of gas, irrecoverable if the agent idles past two epochs.
